Mwingilianomatini ni mbinu, stadi ama taaluma na mwongozo wa uchunguzi wa matini kisayansi, hususani kazi za kisanaa na zisizo za kisanaa ili kubaini kuwepo kwa athari ya uchopekaji ama usemezano; yaani kufanana kifani, kimaudhui na kimbinu kati ya matini moja na nyingine.
Ufanano huo huweza kuwa wa moja kwa moja au kuwapo kwa ukaribiano.
Mwingiliano huo hutambulika pia kama mwangwi.
Inaaminika kwamba, mwingilianomatini ni miongoni mwa mbinu kongwe za kiutunzi, ilhali kiuhakiki inaonekana bado ngeni, haijashughulikiwa sana katika uga wa fasihi na sanaa ya Kiswahili.
Kwa mantiki hiyo, makala haya yatasaidia kuongeza maandiko ya Kiswahili yaliyoshughulikia eneo la uhakiki kupitia nadharia ya mwingilianomatini ili kubaini mwingilianomatini uliopo katika matini, kwa mfano tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu.
Matokeo ya uchambuzi yamebaini kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini mwingi unaofungamana na historia ya makuzi na malezi ya mwandishi kidini (kiroho), kimwili (kiutamaduni na kimaadili), kijamii na kitaaluma – kwa namna moja ama nyingine.
Sehemu ya matokeo hayo ndiyo inayobeba makala haya.
Hivyo basi, makala yanawasilisha mwingilianomatini kati ya tamthilia teule ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na maandiko kutoka vitabu vitakatifu, majazi katika uteuzi na uumbaji wa wahusika, mwangwi wa kifalsafa, anwani za sura au ploti, na mithiolojia ya kiishara.

UTANGULIZI
zinazoingiliana na kupiga mwangwi kutoka kazi bunilizi zilizotangulia kuumbwa (Mningo, 2015).
Kwa hiyo, kila kazi inayofuatia lazima itakuwa na mwangwi wa kazi ya awali.
Kutoka katika mawazo ya Bakhtin, Kristeva akaibua misingi kadhaa iliyosababisha kuzaliwa kwa nadharia ya Mwingilianomatini (Wamitila, 2002 & 2003; Wafula na Njogu, 2007).
Uchambuzi ni mchakato wa kisayansi wa kuyatalii matini kwa lengo la kubaini kilichomo ndani, sababu ya kuwamo hicho kilichobainika, namna kitu hicho kilivyoumbwa na maana inayopatikana katika matini husika kwa lengo la kutoa ufafanuzi kulingana na hadidu za rejea za mchambuzi.
Makala haya yanawasilisha uchambuzi uliolenga kubaini kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini katika tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ya Anitha E. Mgimba.

Aidha, uchambuzi umeonesha dhahiri kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini mkubwa ndani ya tamthilia hii.
Hata hivyo, makala haya yanawasilisha mambo matano pekee yaliyomakinikiwa katika tamthilia teule.
Mambo hayo ni matini za kidini (maandiko kutoka vitabu vitakatifu), majazi katika uteuzi na uumbaji wa wahusika, mwangwi wa kifalsafa, anwani za sura au ploti, na mithiolojia ya ishara.
KIHUNZI CHA NADHARIA
Misingi hiyo ni (i) siyo rahisi na haiwezekani kuiangalia matini kama zao ambalo ni yatima, katika upekee wake na kwa kujibagua, badala yake ni lazima tutambue kuwa kuna matini tangulizi yenye kuhusiana na matini mpya; (ii) matini huingiliana na kuchagizana, kwa hiyo kufikiria ya kwamba matini ya kifasihi inajitosheleza na kujitegemea ni kujitia upofu; na (iii) matini ya kisanaa hukaribisha mitindo fulani ya kiusemi na misimbo fulani fulani ambayo husaidia kuashiria jambo, tukio, kazi au kazi nyingine – ijayo; hivyo kuleta athari kwa kazi bunilizi ijayo (Kristeva, 1980).
Kutokana na misingi hii, tunaweza kusema, mwingilianomatini ni nadharia na stadi za kitaaluma zinazochunguza, kutambua na kufafanua mahusiano yaliyopo kati ya matini moja na matini nyingine, ili kubaini athari za ama moja kwa moja au kimwangwi zinazotokana na matini hizo kuingiliana na kukamilishana.
Kwa maneno mengine, nadharia ya mwingilianomatini ni mwongozo wa uchunguzi wa kazi za sanaa, kisayansi hususani maandiko ya kisanaa ili kubaini kuwepo kwa athari ya uchopekaji ama usemezano; yaani kufanana kifani, kimaudhui na kimbinu kati ya matini moja na matini nyingine.

Tamthilia hii inatathmini athari hizo kisha kupendekeza namna ambavyo ukombozi wa kifikra, kiutamaduni na kijamii unavyopaswa kujenga umoja na ushirikiano kwa jamii kubwa ili kumsaidia mnyonge kujikomboa.
Tamthilia imetumia lugha inayoeleweka kwa haraka na wepesi kwa mtu anayeimudu vema Lugha ya Kiswahili.
Mijadala iliyojengwa katika tamthilia hii inaibua dhamira anuai kama vile ukombozi, nafasi ya mwanamke katika jamii, matabaka, hujuma, ubinafsi, fitina, dhuluma, chuki, wivu, tamaa, usaliti, unyonyaji, manyanyaso, ubaguzi, uwazi na ukweli, mila na desturi, umoja na mshikamano, malezi ya familia, juhudi na maendeleo endelevu, umuhimu wa kutunza nyaraka na utambuzi wa mali, usimamizi na uendelezaji mali, na kadhalika.
Jambo la muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala haya ni kutambua ya kwamba, mwingilianomatini hauwezi kutambulika katika matini kama mchambuzi hana usuli wala ufahamu juu ya maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia zilizomo katika matini mbalimbali tangulizi.
Kwa hiyo, mtu anayeweza kubaini mwingilianomatini katika kazi za kisanaa, hana budi kuwa mjuzi na mchokonozi wa kiwango cha juu, mwenye kiu na njaa ya maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia ya uchokonozi kupitia kazi bunilizi mbalimbali na maandiko ya taaluma anuai.
Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kung’amua mwingilianomatini uliyomo katika kazi bunilizi anayoisoma kwa sababu hatasikia ndani ya ubongo wake mwangwi wa maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia zinazopatikana katika kazi tangulizi.
Tamthilia imesheheni majaribio na mbinu tofauti tofauti za kifani na kinadharia.
Kwa mfano, ndani ya tamthilia mna mwingilianomatini kwa kila sura kupewa mada ndogo yenye kurejelea istilahi za kiisimu za taaluma ya isimu miundo ili kuonesha kuzaliwa hadi kukua kwa jambo linalojadiliwa na mwandishi.
Mwingilianomatini mwingine umo katika matumizi ya michoro-picha, mbinu ya usimulizi na upanuzi usio wa kawaida wa miongozo ya jukwaa, matumizi ya ngoma, nyimbo, muziki, mashairi, majigambo, ngonjera, taswira ya Joka (Mgimba, 2017).
Aidha, hata uteuzi wa jina “Sumukuvu” husadifu tabia na matendo yanayoakisi sifa za kitu au kiumbe husika kunaonesha sifa nyingine ya kazi kuwa na vionjo vya wahusika wa fasihi simulizi.
Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kutazamwa kama mhusika binadamu mwenye jina la aina ya sumu au kama mhusika wa fasihi simulizi aliyehaishwa kwa kupewa uhai kisha kutenda kama mwanadamu.
Sababu hii haitofautiani na kile kinachoelezwa kwa kina na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao maarufu kiitwacho The Psychology of Reading.
Katika kitabu hiki, wataalamu hawa wanaeleza kuwa, kwa kawaida maumbile ya ubongo wa mwanadamu huwa na sehemu yenye kurekodi, kuhifadhi na kurejesha kwa haraka sana kumbukumbu ya mambo na matukio yaliyowahi kumkuta mtu.
Kwa hiyo, msomaji anapokutana na jambo au mbinu aliyowahi kukutana nayo katika kazi fulani aliyowahi kuisoma hapo awali; haraka sana, akili yake hutabasamu na kuamsha hisi za kuvuta urejesho wa jambo au mbinu husika.
Urejeshi wa tukio, jambo au mbinu ya awali dhidi ya kile alichokutana nacho huzalisha makutano ya matini mbili.
Makutano haya huzalisha mwangwi wa tukio, mbinu au jambo ndani ya akili ya msomaji.
Mambo haya yote hufanyika kwa haraka sana.
Kumbe basi, huwezi ukatambua kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini kama wewe siyo msomaji makini au mfuatiliaji makini wa mambo na maandiko tofauti tofauti - kwa wingi na kwa kina.
MUHTASARI WA TAMTHILIA YA UTANGAMANO WETU USHINDI WETU
Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni tamthilia ya Kiswahili yenye mwelekeo wa kifeministi zaidi inayosanisi athari za tabia na matendo ya baadhi ya wanajamii wanaoendekeza imani potofu, wivu, chuki, ubinafsi na manyanyaso kwa watu
Katika tasnia ya Kilimo, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) ni sumu au kemikali za sumu zinazotokana na aina ya fangasi wanaotambulika kwa jina la Kuvu ambao huota na kushambulia zaidi mazao ya chakula na mafuta yatokanayo na mimea itoayo majani na mbegu hasa jamii ya nafaka, mikunde, mizizi, karanga na malisho ya wanyama ndani ya shamba au ghala.
Sumukuvu haionekani kwa macho bali kwa vipimo maalumu vya maabara.
Zaidi ya hayo, tamthilia hii imezitambua taswira kadhaa zikiwemo joka, taa ya kijani, ukungu mzito, giza na ajali.

KUHUSU MWANDISHI ANITHA ELIAS MGIMBA
na kujiamini kila aingiapo uwanjani kuikabili timu pinzani.
Aidha, tofauti na watawa wengi, Anitha amepitia mafunzo ya Jeshi la Kujenga Taifa (J. K. T), Tanzania, kwa mujibu wa sheria katika Kambi ya 832KJ - J. K. T Ruvu, Mkoa wa Pwani, mnamo mwaka 2013.
Sababu ya yeye kwenda jeshini ni Mama Mkuu (aliyechaguliwa kwa awamu nyingine – mara ya tatu), Sr. Teresina Gervasia Kindole, kuwahamasisha na kusisitiza kila aliyechaguliwa kujiunga na mafunzo hayo, kwenda mafunzoni bila kufikiria habari ya utawa wake.
Uamuzi na msimamo huu wa Mama Mkuu unatokana na ukweli kwamba, hata yeye alipitia mafunzo ya J. K. T kwa mujibu wa sheria, hivyo haoni shida kwa watawa wake kuhudhuria mafunzo hayo, kutokana na faida alizozipata jeshini.
Tamthiliya ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni kazi yake ya kwanza kuisana, kuichapisha na kuiingiza sokoni.
Anitha anasema, katika maisha yake “hupendelea zaidi kusoma vitabu vya dini, sosholojia, lugha na fasihi hasa tamthilia kuliko aina nyingine za fasihi.
Hata uandishi wa tamthilia hii una mbinu, na ulimwengu mpana zaidi kutoka katika matini bunilizi, matini ya kisosholojia, kifeministi na maisha halisi yanayotawala jamii zetu.” Kumbe basi, tunaweza kusema ya kwamba, maisha ya utawa na maisha ya kawaida ya jamii inayomzunguka Anitha yamekutana katika umbo la kitamthilia na kusababisha kuzaliwa kwa tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu.
Anitha ana ndoto ya kuandika kazi bunilizi nyingi na bora zaidi.

Theresia wa Mtoto Yesu Iringa, Tanzania.
Alijiunga na shirika hilo mnamo mwaka 2010 chini ya malezi ya Mama Mkuu wa wakati huo Sr. Teresina Gervasia Kindole.

Anitha ni mtoto wa kwanza kati ya watoto sita kwa wazazi wakulima, Mzee Elias Mgimba na Mama Elimunda Mbigi.

Elimu ya msingi aliipata katika Shule ya Msingi Manga (1999 - 2006) wakati elimu ya sekondari ya msingi (2007 – 2010) na elimu ya sekondari ya juu (2011 – 2013) alipata katika Shule ya Sekondari Pandahili, Mkoani Mbeya.
MWINGILIANOMATINI KATIKA UTANGAMANO WETU USHINDI WETU
Uchambuzi uliofanyika katika tamthilia hii umebaini kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini mwingi katika tamthilia hii.
Hata hivyo, kwa minajili ya makala haya, tutawasilisha mwingilianomatini unaohusiana na: maandiko kutoka vitabu vitakatifu, majazi katika uteuzi na uumbaji wa wahusika, mwangwi wa kifalsafa, anwani za sura au ploti, na mithiolojia ya ishara kama sehemu ya kutii matakwa ya idadi ya maneno iliyowekwa na jarida hili.
Elimu ya juu aliipata katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kikatoliki Mwenge, Moshi – Kilimanjaro (2014 - 2017) ambako alisoma na kuhitimu Shahada ya Kwanza ya Elimu katika Sanaa, akitaamilikia Historia na Kiswahili pasipo kusahau kozi ya Uandishi Bunilizi.
Kwa sasa anajiendeleza kitaaluma - ngazi ya Shahada ya Uzamili ya Elimu katika Utawala na Mipango, Chuo Kikuu cha Mtakatifu Augustino Mwanza, Tanzania.
Mbali na masomo ya uzamili, Anitha ni mwalimu wa sekondari akifundisha masomo ya Historia na Kiswahili katika shule ya shirika lake inayoitwa St. John Paul II Iringa.
Chakula anachokipenda ni ugali kwa samaki.
Pia, anapenda huduma ya ualimu kwa jamii.

Majazi katika Uteuzi na Uumbaji wa Wahusika
Jedwali hili linaonesha nukuu tulizozitambua kutoka tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu zenye kufanana au kushabihiana na nukuu kutoka katika Biblia Takatifu.
Huu ni ushahidi usio na shaka kuwa, tamthilia hii haijatungwa kutoka hewani bali mwandishi amechota maarifa, stadi na tajiriba kutoka maandiko matakatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumkuza, kama tulivyodokeza katika wasifu wa mwandishi.
Nukuu zote tulizozirejelea, zinabeba kwa wazi mwangwi wa maandiko tangulizi hivyo kuthibitisha kwa dhati ya kwamba, utunzi na uandishi hauwezi kujitenga na athari ya matini tangulizi au mazingira yaliyomlea na kumkuza mwandishi - kimwili na kiroho.
Ndio maana Worton na Still (1990) wanasisitiza kuwa, kila matini ni kijalizo cha matini nyingine.
Hakuna matini iliyokamilika isiyohitaji kujalizwa na matini nyingine ili iweze kujitosheleza kimaana na kiuelewekaji.
Hii ina maana kwamba, hakuna matini inayofanya kazi kama mfumo funge unaojitegemea wenyewe bali kila matini ni tegemezi kwa matini nyingine tangulizi.
Aidha, athari hii ya mwingilianomatini wa kidini kutokana na kujifunza, kuyaishi maisha ya mafundisho ya dini na kusoma vitabu vitakatifu haupo kwa Anitha pekee, bali hata kazi bunilizi za watunzi nguli kama vile Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban Robert, Sheikh Umar bin al- Ahdaly, kwa uchache kutaja.
Mtu ambaye siyo msomaji wa maandiko matakatifu hawezi kutambua makutano ya tamthilia hii na maandiko matakatifu mathalani Biblia Takatifu kwa sababu hana mifano tangulizi inayoweza kuamsha hisi zake za utambuzi na kumbukizi kupitia mwangwi.
Majazi ni mbinu ya kisanaa anayoitumia mwandishi kuteua jina linalosadifu tabia, mienendo na tajiriba za mhusika katika kazi anayoisana.
Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kumuita mhusika wake “Hasidi.” Ili kusadifisha jina hili, mwandishi hulazimika kumjenga mhusika huyo kutenda mambo kwa husda mwanzo mwisho.
Uteuzi na uumbaji wa tabia za wahusika unaolandana na majina yao ndiyo mbinu ya kisanaa inayoitwa majazi.
Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa hubeba tabia za wahusika bapa (wasiobadilika kitabia) ili kuyatendea haki majina yao kwani wakibadilika kitabia, basi majina hayatasadifu tabia mpya waliyoivaa.
Kwa hiyo, wahusika hawa kitabia na kimsimamo huwa hawabadiliki tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho wa mchezo.
Mlacha na Madumulla (1991) wanawaelezea wahusika wa namna hii kama wahusika ambao huwa hawaonekani kukua kitabia, kimatendo na kisaikolojia.

Mwangwi ni sauti inayorejea kwa mara ya pili baada ya kutolewa kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msituni, wakati falsafa ni elimu ya asili, maana na sababu za mambo au vitu, busara, hekima (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013).
Kwa hiyo, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorejea kwa mara ya pili baada ya kutolewa kupitia elimu ya asili, maana na sababu za mambo au vitu, busara na hekima.
Tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu imempitisha mwanamke katika mapambano makali na machungu ya kujikomboa.

Jambo hili ni mwangwi wa kifalsafa unaotukumbusha habari ya kidole kimoja kutokuvunja chawa na kwamba umoja ni ushindi daima.
Falsafa hii ndiyo inayojitokeza katika tamthilia ya Nguzo Mama (2007) ya Penina Muhando.

Tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu inaonekana kugawa ploti zake kwa kutumia anwani mbili – kuu na ndogo.
Anwani kuu (na anwani ndogo katika mabano) zilizotumika ni: Sehemu ya Kwanza (Neno), Sehemu ya Pili (Virai), Sehemu ya Tatu (Vishazi), Sehemu ya Nne (Sentensi), Sehemu ya Tano (Tungo), Sehemu ya Sita (Aya) na Sehemu ya Saba (Insha).
Tunapotazama maneno yaliyotumika kama anwani ndogo za kutambulisha ploti, tunabaini maneno hayo yanatokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Mofolojia na Sintaksia kama yanavyotambulishwa na kujadiliwa katika Massamba, Kihore na Hokororo (2012) na katika taaluma za stadi za mawasiliano.
Maneno haya si maneno tu bali dhana za kitaaluma zenye kurejelea vitu vya msingi katika taaluma hizi mbili.
Kiisimu, tunatambua ya kwamba maneno haya ni istilahi ambazo hubeba maana za kitaaluma za neno husika ijapokuwa, mpaka sasa hakujawahi kupatikana muafaka wa maana au dhana hizi, “neno,” “virai,” “vishazi,” “sentensi,” “tungo,” “aya” na “insha” (Kipacha, 2005).
Pamoja na kutokuwapo kwa muafaka, hatuna budi kutambua ya kwamba upo ufafanuzi wa kitaaluma unaotolewa na wanataaluma wa stadi za Isimu.
Kwa hiyo, kupitia ufafanuzi huo, tutaweza kuona kama uteuzi wa istilahi hizi za kiisimu unabeba mantiki ya mwingilianomatini kati ya kazi bunilizi ya kifasihi na taaluma ya Isimu.
Kwa mantiki hii, maudhui yanayopatikana katika tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu yamerahisisha mno fasili ya tamthilia ya Nguzo Mama ambayo imechorwa kisitiara.
Huku ndiko kusema, upo usemezano wa kifalsafa na kimtazamo kati ya Anitha E. Mgimba na Penina Muhando kupitia mjadala wa kutafuta suluhisho la njia bora ya kumkomboa mwanamke.
Usemezano huo si mwingine bali falsafa ya kidole kimoja kamwe hakiwezi kuvunja chawa.
Kwa maana kwamba, ukombozi wa kweli wa mwanamke hauwezi kuletwa kwa juhudi binafsi za mwanamke peke yake pasipo kushirikiana na mwanaume ili kuziondoa sirisila zinazomdhibiti mwanamke katika nyuga zote za maisha ya mwanadamu.

Kutokana na ufafanuzi huu tunagundua ya kwamba, neno (maneno) huzaa virai, navyo virai huzaa vishazi, navyo vishazi huzaa sentensi, nazo sentensi huzaa utungo, nazo tungo huzaa aya, kisha aya kadhaa huzaa insha.
Kumbe basi, tunachogundua hapa ni kwamba mwandishi ameyapanga matukio yake kutoka tukio dogo kwenda tukio kubwa; yaani ameanza na jambo dogo lililozaa jambo kubwa, likazaa jambo kubwa kiasi, likazaa jambo kubwa kiasi zaidi, halafu likazaa jambo kubwa zaidi ya kiasi zaidi na hatimaye kukazaliwa jambo kubwa kuliko yote ambalo lilitokana na mkusanyiko wa mambo mengi.
Huu ni mwingilianomatini kati ya fasihi na taaluma ya Isimu.
Mithiolojia ya ishara ni mbinu ya kisanaa inayotumia taswira zinazotambulisha masimulizi jadia ya mwanadamu kuhusu mambo yanayofungamana na imani za nguvu asili na, au sihiri.
Mwandishi ametumia ishara kadhaa zenye kufungamana na mithiolojia, hususani Mithiolojia za Kiafrika.
Mojawapo ya ishara zenye kubeba mithiolojia maarufu miongoni mwa jamii nyingi za Kiafrika na kiulimwengu ni nyoka mkubwa mweusi (Joka).
Kwa mujibu wa Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014), nyoka kitaswira (hasa chatu) huhusishwa na mvua, maji, mnyororo wa ekolojia, uzazi na nguvu za sihiri/jadia, ishara ya mauti na ufufuko.
Mithiolojia iliyobainishwa na mwanazuoni huyu juu ya nyoka na maana zake inaonekana kujitokeza pia katika maandiko matakatifu hususani Biblia Takatifu (Mwanzo 3:14-15, Mwanzo 44:5, Kutoka 7: 8-12, Hesabu 21:6-9, 1 Yohana 3:8, Ufunuo 12:9, Ufunuo 12:17, Ufunuo 20:2,10).
Hii ndiyo sababu, nyoka kama taswira ana nguvu kubwa, kutokana na mapokeo ya kiimani katika tamaduni za jamii mbalimbali, si tu Afrika bali ulimwengu mzima (Hambly, 1929; Lynch na Roberts, 2010; Thomas, 2011; Shanafelt, 2014).
Si Isimu pekee inayoonekana kutoa mwangwi ndani ya tamthilia hii, bali pia upo mwangwi mwingine.

Kupitia nukuu hizi tunabaini ya kwamba tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu imebeba mwingilianomatini wa kiishara wenye kuaksi mithiolojia jadia za Mwafrika na jamii nyingine nje ya bara la Afrika.

Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory. Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. The play "Our Unity, Our Triumph" portrays a woman enduring intense and painful struggles for liberation. Chapter titles or plot titles are subject headings selected by the author to separate sections.

According to the Standard Swahili Dictionary (TUKI, 2013), the word “word” is defined as a group of sounds that are spoken or written together to convey meaning. And so, when words are grouped into different units that have not yet reached the status of a clause or a sentence, they are called phrases (Kipacha, 2005). Therefore, a word and another word form a phrase. Likewise, when phrases are brought together, they form clauses. Massamba (2004) defines a clause as "a construction with a subject and a predicate that exists within a main construction." Several clauses combine to form a sentence; and when several sentences are brought together, they form a construction, which then forms a paragraph, and paragraphs in turn produce an essay. A sentence is a self-contained construction that essentially involves an action and an agent (TUKI, 2013). This Standard Swahili Dictionary (TUKI, 2013) defines the word "tungo" as a structural unit that results from the arrangement of communication, morphology, and syntax, as well as an approach that corresponds to a particular field of study. The mythology of symbols is an artistic approach that uses images representing humanity’s fundamental narratives concerning beliefs related to natural forces and/or magic. The author has used several symbols intertwined with mythology, particularly African mythologies. One of the symbols that carries a well-known mythology among many African communities and globally is the large black serpent (Dragon). According to Morris (in Shanafelt, 2014), the serpent as a symbol (especially the python) is associated with rain, water, the ecological chain, fertility, and magical/spiritual powers, as well as a sign of death and resurrection. The mythology outlined by this scholar regarding the serpent and its meanings also appears in sacred texts, particularly the Holy Bible (Genesis 3:14-15, Genesis 44:5, Exodus 7:8-12, Numbers 21:6-9, 1 John 3:8, Revelation 12:9, Revelation 12:17, Revelation 20:2,10). This is why the serpent, as a symbol, has great power, stemming from faith-based traditions in the cultures of various societies, not only in Africa but throughout the world (Hambly, 1929; Lynch and Roberts, 2010; Thomas, 2011; Shanafelt, 2014). It is not only linguistics that appears to resonate within this play, but there is also another kind of resonance. This resonance is a stylistic similarity between *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* and several other Swahili plays, for example, *Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe* (1988) by Edwin Semzaba and *Nje – Ndani* (2016) by A. A. Majid Mswahili and M. S. Njonjolo. Edwin Semzaba has used skills from the discipline of Geomorphology to select and introduce the plot in order to show the root of the problem up to its impact. This identification has used the following concepts in sequence: Streamlet – Tributaries – River – Channel – To the Sea. Similarly, A. A. Majid Mswahili and M. S. Njonjolo have used methods from the disciplines of health and medicine to select and identify their plots in order to highlight the root of the problem up to its impact. They used the following sequence of manifestations: Initial Trigger – First Symptom (Papule) – Second Symptom (Papules) – Third Symptom (Nodule) – Fourth Symptom (Abscess) – Fifth Symptom (Abscesses) – Sixth Symptom (Ulcer). Moreover, the use of the snake as an artistic symbol is not limited to this play alone but also appears in other Kiswahili creative works. Oral literature, as an ancient art form, often employs large snakes and other creatures to represent God, gods, spirits, humans, or certain concepts through imagery. Misingi hiyo ni (i) siyo rahisi na haiwezekani kuiangalia matini kama zao ambalo ni yatima, katika upekee wake na kwa kujibagua, badala yake ni lazima tutambue kuwa kuna matini tangulizi yenye kuhusiana na matini mpya; (ii) matini huingiliana na kuchagizana, kwa hiyo kufikiria ya kwamba matini ya kifasihi inajitosheleza na kujitegemea ni kujitia upofu; na (iii) matini ya kisanaa hukaribisha mitindo fulani ya kiusemi na misimbo fulani fulani ambayo husaidia kuashiria jambo, tukio, kazi au kazi nyingine – ijayo; hivyo kuleta athari kwa kazi bunilizi ijayo (Kristeva, 1980). Kutokana na misingi hii, tunaweza kusema, mwingilianomatini ni nadharia na stadi za kitaaluma zinazochunguza, kutambua na kufafanua mahusiano yaliyopo kati ya matini moja na matini nyingine, ili kubaini athari za ama moja kwa moja au kimwangwi zinazotokana na matini hizo kuingiliana na kukamilishana. THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK  
These principles are: (i) it is not easy and indeed impossible to view a text as a product that is an orphan, in its own uniqueness and in isolation; instead, we must recognize that there are preceding texts that are related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, so to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is willful blindness; and (iii) an artistic text invites certain modes of expression and specific codes which help to signal an idea, event, work, or another subsequent work—thereby creating an impact on the creative work that follows (Kristeva, 1980). Based on these principles, we can say that intertextuality is a theory and academic skill that examines, identifies, and explains the relationships that exist between one text and another, in order to determine the direct or indirect (echoed) effects resulting from the interactions and mutual reinforcement of these texts. In other words, the theory of intertextuality is a guide for analyzing works of art, with a focus on literary texts, to determine the existence of borrowing or dialogue; that is, resemblance in genre, theme, and technique between one text and another. Mijadala iliyojengwa katika tamthilia hii inaibua dhamira anuai kama vile ukombozi, nafasi ya mwanamke katika jamii, matabaka, hujuma, ubinafsi, fitina, dhuluma, chuki, wivu, tamaa, usaliti, unyonyaji, manyanyaso, ubaguzi, uwazi na ukweli, mila na desturi, umoja na mshikamano, malezi ya familia, juhudi na maendeleo endelevu, umuhimu wa kutunza nyaraka na utambuzi wa mali, usimamizi na uendelezaji mali, na kadhalika.
discourses.translated_txt: The play employs language that is quickly and easily understood by anyone well-versed in Kiswahili. The dialogues constructed in this play evoke a variety of themes such as liberation, the role of women in society, social classes, sabotage, selfishness, intrigue, oppression, hatred, jealousy, greed, betrayal, exploitation, abuse, discrimination, transparency and truth, customs and traditions, unity and solidarity, family upbringing, effort and sustainable development, the importance of preserving records and identifying property, as well as the management and advancement of property, among others.

discourses.source_txt: Jambo la muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala haya ni kutambua ya kwamba, mwingilianomatini hauwezi kutambulika katika matini kama mchambuzi hana usuli wala ufahamu juu ya maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia zilizomo katika matini mbalimbali tangulizi. Kwa hiyo, mtu anayeweza kubaini mwingilianomatini katika kazi za kisanaa, hana budi kuwa mjuzi na mchokonozi wa kiwango cha juu, mwenye kiu na njaa ya maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia ya uchokonozi kupitia kazi bunilizi mbalimbali na maandiko ya taaluma anuai. Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kung’amua mwingilianomatini uliyomo katika kazi bunilizi anayoisoma kwa sababu hatasikia ndani ya ubongo wake mwangwi wa maarifa, mbinu, stadi na tabia zinazopatikana katika kazi tangulizi.
discourses.translated_txt: What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works.

discourses.source_txt: Aidha, hata uteuzi wa jina “Sumukuvu” husadifu tabia na matendo yanayoakisi sifa za kitu au kiumbe husika kunaonesha sifa nyingine ya kazi kuwa na vionjo vya wahusika wa fasihi simulizi. Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kutazamwa kama mhusika binadamu mwenye jina la aina ya sumu au kama mhusika wa fasihi simulizi aliyehaishwa kwa kupewa uhai kisha kutenda kama mwanadamu.
discourses.translated_txt: In addition, even the choice of the name “Sumukuvu,” which reflects traits and actions that signify the qualities of a particular thing or being, demonstrates another aspect of the work: the presence of features typical of characters in oral literature. For example, the character Sumukuvu can be seen either as a human character with a name resembling that of a poison or as a character from oral literature who has been personified and given life, then acts as a human being.

discourses.source_txt: Sababu hii haitofautiani na kile kinachoelezwa kwa kina na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao maarufu kiitwacho The Psychology of Reading. Katika kitabu hiki, wataalamu hawa wanaeleza kuwa, kwa kawaida maumbile ya ubongo wa mwanadamu huwa na sehemu yenye kurekodi, kuhifadhi na kurejesha kwa haraka sana kumbukumbu ya mambo na matukio yaliyowahi kumkuta mtu. Kwa hiyo, msomaji anapokutana na jambo au mbinu aliyowahi kukutana nayo katika kazi fulani aliyowahi kuisoma hapo awali; haraka sana, akili yake hutabasamu na kuamsha hisi za kuvuta urejesho wa jambo au mbinu husika. Urejeshi wa tukio, jambo au mbinu ya awali dhidi ya kile alichokutana nacho huzalisha makutano ya matini mbili. Makutano haya huzalisha mwangwi wa tukio, mbinu au jambo ndani ya akili ya msomaji. Mambo haya yote hufanyika kwa haraka sana.
discourses.translated_txt: This reason is consistent with what is thoroughly explained by Taylor and Taylor (1983) in their well-known book The Psychology of Reading. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly.

discourses.source_txt: Kumbe basi, huwezi ukatambua kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini kama wewe siyo msomaji makini au mfuatiliaji makini wa mambo na maandiko tofauti tofauti - kwa wingi na kwa kina.

discourses.translated_txt:
SUMMARY OF THE PLAY OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
Our Cohesion Our Triumph is a Swahili play with a strong feminist orientation, synthesizing the effects of the behaviors and actions of certain members of society who perpetuate misguided beliefs, envy, hatred, selfishness, and various forms of abuse toward others.  
In the agricultural sector, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) refers to a poison or toxic chemicals produced by a type of fungus known as Kuvu, which grows and frequently attacks food crops and oil-yielding plants, especially those with leaves and seeds, notably cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal feeds either on the farm or in storage.

discourses.source_txt: Sumukuvu haionekani kwa macho bali kwa vipimo maalumu vya maabara. Zaidi ya hayo, tamthilia hii imezitambua taswira kadhaa zikiwemo joka, taa ya kijani, ukungu mzito, giza na ajali.

INTERTEXTUALITY IN OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
The analysis conducted on this play has revealed that there is a great deal of intertextuality present within it. discourses.source_txt: Huu ni ushahidi usiopingika kwamba, mawazo na misingi ya Mikhail Bakhtin na Julia Kristeva siyo ya kusadikika bali halisi yenye mashiko kisayansi kwa kuwa (i) siyo rahisi na haiwezekani kuiangalia matini kama zao ambalo ni peke, katika upekee wake na kwa kujibagua, badala yake ni lazima kutakuwa na matini tangulizi yenye kuhusiana na matini mpya; (ii) matini huingiliana na kuchagizana, kwa hiyo kufikiria kwamba matini ya kifasihi inajitosheleza na kujitegemea ni upotofu; (iii) matini ya kisanaa hukaribisha mitindo fulani ya kiusemi na misimbo fulani fulani ambayo husaidia kuashiria jambo, tukio, kazi au kazi nyingine – ijayo.
discourses.translated_txt: This is irrefutable evidence that the ideas and foundations of Mikhail Bakhtin and Julia Kristeva are not merely speculative but are concrete and scientifically valid, because (i) it is neither easy nor possible to regard a text as a unique product, in its singularity and in isolation; instead, there must be preceding texts related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, therefore to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is erroneous; (iii) an artistic text invites certain stylistic forms of expression and particular codes that help signify an idea, event, work, or subsequent works.

discourses.source_txt: Huu ni ushahidi usio na shaka kuwa, tamthilia hii haijatungwa kutoka hewani bali mwandishi amechota maarifa, stadi na tajiriba kutoka maandiko matakatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumkuza, kama tulivyodokeza katika wasifu wa mwandishi. Nukuu zote tulizozirejelea, zinabeba kwa wazi mwangwi wa maandiko tangulizi hivyo kuthibitisha kwa dhati ya kwamba, utunzi na uandishi hauwezi kujitenga na athari ya matini tangulizi au mazingira yaliyomlea na kumkuza mwandishi - kimwili na kiroho.
discourses.translated_txt: This is indisputable evidence that this play was not created out of thin air, but rather the writer drew knowledge, skills, and experience from the sacred writings of the religion that raised and nurtured him, as we noted in the writer’s biography. All the quotations we referenced clearly reflect the echoes of earlier texts, thus strongly confirming that composition and writing cannot be divorced from the influence of preceding texts or the physical and spiritual environments that raised and shaped the writer.

discourses.source_txt: Ndio maana Worton na Still (1990) wanasisitiza kuwa, kila matini ni kijalizo cha matini nyingine.
discourses.translated_txt: That is why Worton and Still (1990) emphasize that every text is a supplement to another text.

discourses.source_txt: Hakuna matini iliyokamilika isiyohitaji kujalizwa na matini nyingine ili iweze kujitosheleza kimaana na kiuelewekaji. Hii ina maana kwamba, hakuna matini inayofanya kazi kama mfumo funge unaojitegemea wenyewe bali kila matini ni tegemezi kwa matini nyingine tangulizi.
discourses.translated_txt: There is no text that is complete and does not require supplementation from other texts in order to be meaningful and comprehensible. This means that no text functions as a closed, self-contained system; rather, every text is dependent on preceding texts.

discourses.source_txt: Aidha, athari hii ya mwingilianomatini wa kidini kutokana na kujifunza, kuyaishi maisha ya mafundisho ya dini na kusoma vitabu vitakatifu haupo kwa Anitha pekee, bali hata kazi bunilizi za watunzi nguli kama vile Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban Robert, Sheikh Umar bin al- Ahdaly, kwa uchache kutaja.
discourses.translated_txt: Moreover, this effect of intertextuality arising from learning, living according to religious teachings, and reading holy books is not limited to Anitha alone, but is also present in the creative works of renowned authors such as Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban Robert, Sheikh Umar bin al-Ahdaly, to mention just a few.

discourses.translated_txt: A person who is not a reader of the sacred texts cannot recognize this play’s intersections with the sacred texts, such as the Holy Bible, because they lack the prior examples that could awaken their sense of recognition and recollection through intertextual resonance.

discourses.source_txt: Majazi ni mbinu ya kisanaa anayoitumia mwandishi kuteua jina linalosadifu tabia, mienendo na tajiriba za mhusika katika kazi anayoisana. Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kumuita mhusika wake “Hasidi.” Ili kusadifisha jina hili, mwandishi hulazimika kumjenga mhusika huyo kutenda mambo kwa husda mwanzo mwisho. Uteuzi na uumbaji wa tabia za wahusika unaolandana na majina yao ndiyo mbinu ya kisanaa inayoitwa majazi.
discourses.translated_txt: Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory.

discourses.source_txt: Kwa kawaida, wahusika hawa hubeba tabia za wahusika bapa (wasiobadilika kitabia) ili kuyatendea haki majina yao kwani wakibadilika kitabia, basi majina hayatasadifu tabia mpya waliyoivaa. Kwa hiyo, wahusika hawa kitabia na kimsimamo huwa hawabadiliki tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho wa mchezo. Mlacha na Madumulla (1991) wanawaelezea wahusika wa namna hii kama wahusika ambao huwa hawaonekani kukua kitabia, kimatendo na kisaikolojia.
discourses.translated_txt: Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically.

For example, the character Sumukuvu can be viewed as a human character bearing a name that resembles a type of poison, or as a character from oral literature who has been personified by being given life and then behaves like a human being.

discourses.source_txt: Katika tasnia ya Kilimo, sumukuvu (mycotoxin) ni sumu au kemikali za sumu inayotokana na aina ya fangasi wanaotambulika kwa jina la Kuvu ambao huota na kushambulia zaidi mazao ya chakula na mafuta yatokanayo na mimea itoayo majani na mbegu hasa jamii ya nafaka, mikunde, mizizi, karanga na malisho ya wanyama ndani ya shamba au ghala.
discourses.translated_txt: In the agricultural sector, a mycotoxin is a poison or toxic chemical produced by certain types of fungi known as molds, which primarily infest and attack food and oil crops derived from leafy plants and seeds, especially cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal fodder, either in the field or in storage facilities.

discourses.source_txt: Sumukuvu haionekani kwa macho bali kwa vipimo maalumu vya maabara. Viashiria ya kuwapo kwa sumukuvu katika zao ni pamoja na zao (mbegu) husika kuonekana kuoza au kuwa na rangi tofauti na ile ya asili yake.
discourses.translated_txt: Mycotoxin cannot be seen with the naked eye but is detected through special laboratory tests. Indicators of the presence of mycotoxin in a crop include the affected crop (seed) appearing rotten or having a color different from its original one.

discourses.source_txt: Nukuu hii inathibitisha kuwapo kwa mwingilianomatini kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na stadi za taaluma ya Kilimo. Lakini pia, huu ni ushahidi kwamba kuna usemezano wa kimbinu kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na uteuzi na uumbaji wa wahusika katika kazi bunilizi za watunzi wengine akiwemo Shaaban Robert kupitia riwaya za Kufikirika, Utubora Mkulima na Kusadikika. Mbinu hii ya kuwapatia wahusika majina yanayoendana na tabia na matendo yao ni maarufu sana katika kazi bunilizi nyingi za Shaaban Robert (Ambrose, 2014; Saleh, 2015).
discourses.translated_txt: This quotation confirms the existence of intertextuality between the play Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu and the academic field of agriculture. But it is also evidence that there is a methodological dialogue between the play Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu and the selection and creation of characters in creative works by other authors, including Shaaban Robert through his novels Kufikirika, Utubora Mkulima, and Kusadikika. The technique of giving characters names that correspond with their personalities and actions is very popular in many of Shaaban Robert’s creative works (Ambrose, 2014; Saleh, 2015).

Mwangwi wa Kifalsafa na Kimtazamo
Mwangwi ni sauti inayorejea kwa mara ya pili baada ya kutolewa kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msituni, wakati falsafa ni elimu ya asili, maana na sababu za mambo au vitu, busara, hekima (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Kwa hiyo, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorejea kwa mara ya pili baada ya kutolewa kupitia elimu ya asili, maana na sababu za mambo au vitu, busara na hekima.
discourses.translated_txt:
Philosophical and Conceptual Echo

An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence.

We have cited some statements that illustrate a small part of Sumukuvu’s behavior, conduct, and actions, and their impact on his younger brother’s family, his own family, and the wider clan. These quotations, along with others we have not cited, show how the name Sumukuvu truly turned into poison—even causing Damiano’s death, leading some disloyal soldiers in the family, Sumukuvu’s customers to experience losses, and leaving them with cases to answer after being caught with stolen goods they had bought from Sumukuvu.

discourses.translated_txt: While Sumukuvu himself distanced himself from his family and clan by fleeing to an unknown location after failing to reach an understanding with them and upon hearing that he was being sought by the police for charges of conspiring to steal and attempted murder.

discourses.source_txt: Kabla ya Sumukuvu kuingia katika maisha ya familia na ukoo, jamii hizi zilikuwa zimestawi katika kila uga wa maisha. Hakuna aliyewahi kufikiria kama kuna siku zitaishia kuoza, visasi na mafarakano.
discourses.translated_txt: Before Sumukuvu became involved with his family and clan, these communities had flourished in every aspect of life. No one had ever imagined that one day they would end up decaying, with feuds and divisions.

discourses.translated_txt: The title serves as the identifier of the chapter or scenes within a written play. The play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* appears to organize its plot using two types of titles – main and sub-titles.

discourses.source_txt: Anwani kuu (na anwani ndogo katika mabano) zilizotumika ni: Sehemu ya Kwanza (Neno), Sehemu ya Pili (Virai), Sehemu ya Tatu (Vishazi), Sehemu ya Nne (Sentensi), Sehemu ya Tano (Tungo), Sehemu ya Sita (Aya) na Sehemu ya Saba (Insha). Tunapotazama maneno yaliyotumika kama anwani ndogo za kutambulisha ploti, tunabaini maneno hayo yanatokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Mofolojia na Sintaksia kama yanavyotambulishwa na kujadiliwa katika Massamba, Kihore na Hokororo (2012) na katika taaluma za stadi za mawasiliano.
discourses.translated_txt: The main titles (and sub-titles in brackets) used are: Part One (Word), Part Two (Phrase), Part Three (Clauses), Part Four (Sentence), Part Five (Composition), Part Six (Paragraph), and Part Seven (Essay). When we look at the words used as sub-titles to identify the plot, we find that these words are derived from the field of Linguistics – Morphology and Syntax as described and discussed in Massamba, Kihore, and Hokororo (2012), as well as in the field of communication skills.

discourses.source_txt: Maneno haya si maneno tu bali dhana za kitaaluma zenye kurejelea vitu vya msingi katika taaluma hizi mbili. Kiisimu, tunatambua ya kwamba maneno haya ni istilahi ambazo hubeba maana za kitaaluma za neno husika ijapokuwa, mpaka sasa hakujawahi kupatikana muafaka wa maana au dhana hizi, “neno,” “virai,” “vishazi,” “sentensi,” “tungo,” “aya” na “insha” (Kipacha, 2005).
discourses.translated_txt: These words are not just mere words but academic concepts that refer to fundamental elements in these two disciplines. Linguistically, we recognize that these are terms that carry technical meanings of the respective word, although, up to now, there has never been a consensus on the meaning or these concepts—“word,” “phrase,” “clause,” “sentence,” “composition,” “paragraph,” and “essay” (Kipacha, 2005).

discourses.source_txt: Pamoja na kutokuwapo kwa muafaka, hatuna budi kutambua ya kwamba upo ufafanuzi wa kitaaluma unaotolewa na wanataaluma wa stadi za Isimu. discourses.translated_txt: Although there is no consensus, we must acknowledge that there is an academic explanation provided by linguistics scholars. discourses.translated_txt: Moreover, the use of the snake as an artistic symbol is not limited to this play alone but also appears in other Kiswahili creative works.

discourses.source_txt: Fasihi simulizi kama sanaa kongwe inaonekana kutumia sana nyoka wakubwa na viumbe wengine kumwakilisha Mungu, miungu, mizimu, binadamu, au dhana fulani kwa njia ya taswira. Kwa hiyo, taswira ya viumbe mathalani nyoka wakubwa ni sehemu ya utajiri unaobebwa katika masimulizi jadia tunayoyaona hata katika fasihi simulizi na fasihi andishi za kijadia (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009).
discourses.translated_txt: Oral literature, as an ancient art form, often employs large snakes and other creatures to represent God, gods, spirits, humans, or certain concepts through imagery. Therefore, the imagery of creatures such as large snakes is part of the richness carried in traditional narratives, which we also observe in both oral and written traditional literature (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009).

discourses.source_txt: Baadhi ya kazi bunilizi zenye usemezano wa nyoka mkubwa kimaana na kiishara, tunazoweza kuzihusisha na tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni pamoja na: Adili na Nduguze (Robert, 1952), Mtu Maarufu katika Historia ya Usukuma (Boaz, 1974), Ngao ya Jadi (Hussein, 1976), Shujaa Gishegu (Masatu, hakuna mwaka), Nondo Mla Watu, Nunda Mla Watu na Hadithi Nyingine (Hellier, 1964), Ngoma ya Ng’wanamalundi (Mbogo, 1988) na Gamba la Nyoka (Kezilahabi, 2006). Katika kazi hizi zote, matumizi ya nyoka mkubwa yamebeba umaajabu wa kisihiri unaoashiria mojawapo kati ya utajiri, mauti, ulinzi na usalama, uponyaji na afya, sihiri, uzazi, udhalimu, mateso, mamlaka, kutaja kwa uchache.
discourses.translated_txt: Some of the imaginative works featuring the use of the large snake both symbolically and in meaning, which we can associate with the play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, include: *Adili and His Brothers* (Robert, 1952), *A Famous Person in the History of Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Traditional Shield* (Hussein, 1976), *Hero Gishegu* (Masatu, no year), *The Man-Eating Nondo*, *The Man-Eating Nunda and Other Stories* (Hellier, 1964), *The Dance of Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), and *The Snake’s Skin* (Kezilahabi, 2006). In all these works, the use of the large snake carries an element of magical wonder, signifying, among other things, wealth, death, protection and security, healing and health, witchcraft, fertility, oppression, suffering, and authority.
